comment: The step jacks and the row outputs carry whatever is patched in, so they are given no family. The steps CV takes the floor of the voltage and is clamped up to 1, so anything below 1V gives a single step. The step lamps are lights rather than params and cannot be clicked. The maker's step jack tooltips read a one, a two and so on; the panel prints the row letter in brackets down the left and the step names across the top.
